newsitem.title: USA: PG&E finalizes holding company structure.
newsitem.headline: PG&E finalizes holding company structure.

text.p: Pacific Gas and Electric Co said Wednesday its board gave final approval to the formation of a new holding company structure, effective January 1.

"The holding company structure will improve our ability to respond to new business opportunities and changes in the industry," said Stanley Skinner, PG&E's chairman. "It will enhance the financial separation of our businesses, and provide more financing flexibility."

Under the new structure, PG&E and its two principal subsidiaries, Pacific Gas Transmission Company and PG&E Enterprises, each will become subsidiaries of the holding company, which will be named PG&E Corp.
"The formation of PG&E Corp will not change in any way PG&E's California utility operations, its workforce, or its relationship with customers," Skinner said.

When the holding company is formed on January 1, Pacific Gas and Electric Co common stock will automatically become PG&E Corp common stock on a share-for-share basis. Preferred stock will remain a security of Pacific Gas and Electric Co.

PG&E Corp's stock ticker symbol will be PCG, the current stock symbol for Pacific Gas and Electric Co. PG&E Corp common stock will be listed on the New York, Pacific and Swiss stock exchanges. Pacific Gas and Electric Co's preferred stock will continue to be listed on the American and Pacific stock exchanges.
The holding company structure was approved by PG&E shareholders last April as well as by various regulatory agencies earlier this year.
PG&E Corp will be overseen by a small number of officers who also will continue in their current capacities as officers of the utility subsidiary, Pacific Gas and Electric Co. the company said.

The senior officers will be Stanley Skinner, chairman and chief executive officer of both companies, and Robert Glynn, Jr., president and chief operating officer of both companies. The current directors of Pacific Gas and Electric Co will also serve as the directors of PG&E Corp.
